map.多方指数 n 过程的体积功: Volume work of a polytropic process with index n
map.输入初末态压力与体积及多方指数 n，求过程功。: Enter pressure and volume at both ends of one polytropic process plus the index n; the endpoint relation is checked before computing the work.
map.📖 查看「多方指数 n 过程的体积功 使用指南」: View "Volume work of a polytropic process with index n" guide
map.W=(P₂V₂−P₁V₁)/(1−n)（SI 单位）。 n=1 时退化为等温，需: W=(P2 V2-P1 V1)/(1-n) (SI units). At n=1 it degenerates to isothermal and the ln form must be used instead.
map.n=1 时退化为等温，需另用 ln 式。: At n=1 it degenerates to isothermal and the ln form must be used instead.
map.理想气体多变过程（pV^n=C）体积功。: Volume work of an ideal-gas polytropic process (pV^n=C).
map.n=1 等温、n=γ 绝热、n=0 等压的特例。: Special cases: n=1 isothermal, n=gamma adiabatic, n=0 isobaric.
map.n=1 且 p1v1=p2v2 时 W=0（理想等温闭合）。: At n=1 and p1 v1=p2 v2, W=0 (ideal isothermal closure).
map.多变指数，描述热量交换程度；升温压缩 n 介于 1～γ 间。: Polytropic index, describing the degree of heat exchange; during heating compression n lies between 1 and gamma.
map.压缩时气体体积减小，外界对气体做功，W 为负。: During compression the gas volume decreases, work is done on the gas, so W is negative.
map.W=(P₂V₂−P₁V₁)/(1−n)（SI 单位）；n=1 时按等温特例 W=: W = (P₂V₂ − P₁V₁)/(1 − n) in SI units; for n ≈ 1 use the isothermal special case W = p₁V₁·ln(V₂/V₁). Validation: P₁, V₁, P₂, V₂ > 0 and n finite; the endpoints must satisfy the same polytropic relation P₁V₁ⁿ = P₂V₂ⁿ (relative error ≤ 1%), otherwise the calculation is rejected and the implied P₂ is shown.
map.压力与体积都必须大于 0。: Pressure and volume must both be greater than 0.
map.⚠ 压力与体积都必须大于 0。: ⚠ Pressure and volume must both be greater than 0.
map.输入初末态压力与体积及多方指数 n，求过程功；压力与体积必须大于 0。: Enter the initial/final pressure and volume and the polytropic index n to find the process work; pressure and volume must both be greater than 0.
map.W=(P₂V₂−P₁V₁)/(1−n)（SI 单位）；n≈1 时按等温特例 W=: W = (P₂V₂ − P₁V₁)/(1 − n) in SI units; for n ≈ 1 use the isothermal special case W = p₁V₁·ln(V₂/V₁). Validation: P₁, V₁, P₂, V₂ > 0 and n finite; the endpoints must satisfy P₁V₁ⁿ = P₂V₂ⁿ within 1%, otherwise the calculation is rejected and the implied P₂ is shown.
map.⚠ 多方指数 n 必须是有限数值。: ⚠ The polytropic index n must be a finite number.
map.端点不满足同一多方过程关系: Endpoints do not satisfy the same polytropic relation
map.n≈1：按等温 pV=常数 的 W=p₁V₁ln(V₂/V₁): n≈1: isothermal pV = constant, W = p₁V₁ln(V₂/V₁)
